scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run db:migrate:local --workspace=backend && npm run db:seed:local --workspace=backend && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace=frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config backend/wrangler.toml
